title: How Mass Warps Space and Slows Time
description:
Einstein revealed that gravity is not a force pulling objects together, it is the curvature of spacetime caused by mass.

Near a massive body, spacetime bends so strongly that clocks physically tick slower. GPS satellites must correct for this effect every day, or navigation would drift by kilometres.
